name: BrightBean Chat
description: Self-hosted chat-marketing automation: flows, broadcasts, sequences and a shared inbox across Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, SMS and email. Postgres only — no Redis, no message broker.

DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE.description: Production settings. This is what forces DEBUG off, turns on HSTS and the SSL redirect, and makes the app refuse to boot without the two keys below.

DJANGO_ENV_FILE.description: Points the settings loader at a path that does not exist, so config vars are the only source of configuration. Do not change this.

SECRET_KEY.description: Django's signing key, and the input to credential encryption. Generated for you; never share it, and back it up before you need it.

ENCRYPTION_KEY_SALT.description: HKDF salt for the AES-256-GCM encrypted fields that hold your platform credentials. Generated for you. Losing this makes every stored credential unreadable, so back it up alongside SECRET_KEY and separately from any database dump.

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: The hostname this app answers on, with no scheme. If you named the app 'my-chat' above, that is 'my-chat.herokuapp.com'. Add your custom domain here too, comma-separated, once you attach one. Django answers 400 to every request whose Host header is not listed — including the health check.

APP_URL.description: The public origin, including https://. Used to build unsubscribe, click-tracking and media links, and the webhook URLs you paste into each platform's dashboard. For example https://my-chat.herokuapp.com

TICK_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for /internal/tick, an HTTP wrapper around one worker cycle. The worker dyno below is what normally drains the queue; this is the fallback for running without one (Heroku Scheduler, or an external pinger every minute). The route answers 404 while this is unset, so an unused one exposes nothing.

EMAIL_HOST.description: SMTP server for password reset and address verification. Leave blank to skip — nothing else is gated on email delivery, but password reset cannot work without it.

DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL.description: The From address on messages this app sends about itself.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Optional error reporting. Leave blank to disable Sentry entirely.
